cohort: The study included 67 prepubertal boys with premature adrenarche, with a mean age of 8.3 years.
finding: In prepubertal boys with premature adrenarche, higher BMI and DHEA-S z-scores were associated with advanced bone age, with obesity directly impacting skeletal maturation rather than through increased adrenal androgen levels.
cross-section timing: Data were analyzed for prepubertal boys with premature adrenarche at a mean age of 8.3 years.
